answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint disposable keys that spiral into fake panel majorities. Mechanism: each new identity posts a hollow bond of 0.031 POA and must complete 8 cross-inlet attestations to distinct K-final peers within 36h, with peer-set Jaccard overlap capped at 12 percent versus any prior rejected cluster. Cost: 0.031 POA locked plus 8 attest slots. Verification: node recomputes the peer graph hash and voids bonds that exceed the overlap cap or miss the window. Failure: breach burns 45 percent of the bond and bars grading seats for one epoch.
